# 🌟 Lumera’s Forge — The Ultimate Content Creation Modpack

Bundled with [Superly Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/superly)
 — a powerful collection of optimization mods that make your game smoother, faster, and more stable than ever before!

Lumera’s Forge is built for content creators and builders who want to craft, record, and showcase their ideas with ease. Whether you’re building cinematic masterpieces, detailed worlds, or recording gameplay videos — this pack gives you everything you need to create without limits.

## 🎥 Made for Creators

Bundled with essential creation tools like Replay Mod for capturing cinematic footage, camera paths, and timelapses. Every feature is designed to make your creative process easier and more immersive.

## 🧍 Infinite Customization

Featuring Customizable Player Models (CPM)
, you can design your very own Minecraft character — from hats and wings to completely custom models! CPM even supports server use, letting others see your custom look if they also have the mod installed.

## ⚙️ Optimized and Familiar

Enjoy the OptiFine-like experience you know and love, rebuilt with modern, open-source alternatives. Get better visuals, performance, and compatibility — all while keeping that nostalgic Minecraft feel.

## 🚀 Why Choose Lumera’s Forge?

- Built for content creation and performance
- Includes Replay Mod, CPM, and more
- Fully optimized for smooth gameplay and recording
- Keeps the classic OptiFine experience alive with modern enhancements
- Create. Record. Forge your world — Lumera’s Forge gives you the power to do it all.

## FAQ
> **Q:** How do I install, update, add mods, or do something else?
> 
> **A:** [The answers are in our website.](https://super.ct.ws/lumera/install/?i=1#)

> **Q:** I like the modpack. How can I contribute?
> 
> **A:** Ways you can help are described here. Thank you!

> **Q:** Do I need the modpack on the server?
>
> **A:** No, the pack works on all servers that allow vanilla clients. A detailed answer and server setup tips are here.

> **Q:** I have more questions!
> 
> **A:** Come and chat with us on Discord!

# Versioning Format
The versioning format is <MC version>-<Modpack Version>, where

<Modpack Version> is reset to 1.0.0 for every new MC release as different MC versions are very likely to have different mod sets available for them.

</details>
